Name: Lekku Fashion Sense
Author: FoolishGent
Description:
Star Wars alien themed hairstyles for Fashion Sense.  Twi'leks, Togrutas, and Nautolans, oh my! 

[b][u]Includes:[/u][/b]

[b]Hairs:[/b]
6 Twi'lek variations
2 Togruta variatons 
2 Nautolan variations
Ahsoka 
Hera 

[b]Accessories:[/b]
2 Togruta Face Marking variations

Colors:
Waste no time getting these to match your character, Twi'lek and Nautolan looks will pull their color directly from your Farmer's selected skin tone. This is compatible with any skin tone mod you're using.

[b][u]Installation:
[/u][/b]1. Download and install the required mods. 
2. Download this mod's .zip file.
3. Unpack the zip into the "Stardew Valley/Mods" folder created by SMAPI
4. Run the game with SMAPI
5. Access hairstyles through the Hand Mirror.
